verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes a documented public REST API at apidocs.anrok.com. It covers customers, transactions (createOrUpdate, createEphemeral, void, negation), address resolution, tax IDs, product mappings, and filings, with bearer-token auth, curl examples, rate-limit/429 semantics, and an openapi.yaml spec. The probe's 404s on openapi.json paths don't contradict this, since the cited spec is served as YAML. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and an llms.txt index (probe returned 404).
